title: Cheaper layout-only for wide padded files
lead: Find out whether layout-only profiling (sq-47) can be made faster on wide padded files with a small byte limit, by shrinking the 1,000-record header sample for a small `MaxBytes`, or by fusing the byte pass and the scoring pass, while the layout stays equal to the full profile's. **Not in this slice:** changing the default profile, the layout decision rules, or the field accumulation (already skipped by sq-47).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: sq-47 measured that layout-only saves little on the shape that motivated it: a wide padded table (256 columns x 64 bytes, 64 MiB): estimated memory 47.9 MB vs 53.2 MB full and the same time (4.2 s vs 4.2 s); a 1 MiB prefix of it: 40 percent memory, no speedup. The cost is tokenizing plus the header sample the layout decision needs. It is cheaper only for many rows (150,000 x 12: 11.7 percent memory, 1.4x) or many columns (2,000 x 3 rows: 1 percent, 2.9x). Owner decision on sq-47: "Accept, amend the spec, file a follow-up (Recommended)". The consumer's real shape is about 38 KB per line (about 25 rows in 1 MiB), not the 16 KB-line synthetic.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `DelimitedPass` (header sample, `Decide`), `RecordTokenizer`, `HeaderDetector`, the byte pass (`ByteSniffer`), `Profiler`; `tests/squalify.Tests/LayoutOnlyTests.cs` and the Cheaper tests; `tests/squalify.Tests/Bench/*` (add a 38 KB-line shape)
- docs/design.md, user-guide.md (the layout-only figures), how-it-works.md if the pipeline changes

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- **Layout equal:** the layout-only descriptor equals the full profile's (the sq-47 deny-list comparison) on every fixture and every shape, with and without a byte limit, after the change.
- **Measured:** a 38 KB-line wide padded shape (1 MiB prefix, about 25 rows) and the 16 KB-line shape: the figures before and after are printed; the test asserts the estimate bound, not the timing.
- **Determinism and the default profile unchanged:** every golden byte-identical; same bytes twice and under another culture give the same descriptor.
- Mutation-check each test.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Profile where the time goes on the 38 KB-line prefix (tokenizing, header sample, byte pass) and report it as a note. 2. Only if a saving exists that keeps the layout equal, write the failing tests and implement it; otherwise close the slice with the finding (a note, no change). 3. Docs in the same change.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: The owner commits. Do not commit; never add Co-Authored-By or similar lines.
